troubleshooting.fix: Ask for molded plastic texture, visible joints, toy-scale proportions, and packaging photography.
Keep package copy short: one title, two callouts, and simple label blocks.
Name specific identity cues such as hairstyle, glasses, outfit colors, and pose.
